department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment (DFFE)
headquarters: Environment House, 473 Steve Biko Road, Arcadia, Pretoria, South Africa
compactDirectoryIndex: 1. Biodiversity & Conservation (NEMBA, NEMPAA, TOPS permits, SANParks/SANBI, 30x30 target, Nagoya Bioprospecting, NISCWT anti-poaching)
2. Chemicals & Waste Management (NEMWA, SAWIC/SAWIS telemetry, Section 18 EPR, Circular Economy, hazardous waste, Stockholm/Minamata POPs)
3. Climate Change & Air Quality (Climate Change Act 22 of 2024, Sector Emission Targets, Carbon Budgets, 2030 NDC, NEMAQA, SAAQIS, NAEIS)
4. Corporate Management Services [CMS] (Chief Directorate: GITO -> Directorate: IT Business Solutions [ITBS], SharePoint/M365 Intranet, Power Platform, HR Leave/Onboarding, Legal Services)
5. Environmental Programmes [EPWP] (Working for Water, Working on Fire, Working for Wetlands, Working for the Coast, Working on Waste, Ten Million Trees, Groen Sebenza)
6. Financial Management Services [FMS] (PFMA Act 1 of 1999 compliance, Supply Chain Management [SCM], SITA ICT procurement, RFQs/Tenders, GEF/Green Climate Fund)
7. Forestry Management (National Forests Act 84 of 1998, Commercial Forestry Masterplan, Indigenous State Forests, Champion & Protected Trees licensing, NVFFA wildfire standards)
8. Regulatory Compliance & Sector Monitoring [RCSM] (NEMA Section 24 EIA Listing Notices 1-3, National Environmental Screening Tool, REDZ 57-day fast-track, Green Scorpions [EMIs], Section 24G & 31L)
9. Oceans & Coasts (NEM:ICMA, OCIMS satellite VMS & SAR surveillance, Marine Spatial Planning, 42 Marine Protected Areas, Operation Phakisa Blue Economy, Estuaries)
10. Fisheries Management (Marine Living Resources Act [MLRA], FRAP 22 commercial sectors, e-Fishing permits, 315+ Small-Scale Fishing Co-operatives, TAC/TAE stock assessments)
